final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor provided no genuinely new admissible evidence and instead narrowed the claim using the same record. That narrowing is directionally more accurate, but it does not close the initial concerns. The admissible evidence still supports only a caveated certification theory in which the emergency shelter placement limitation is explicitly disclosed before launch, while the current record still contains a contradictory model-card draft, an incomplete draft runbook, and no approved risk acceptance or decision record confirming the disclosure condition has been satisfied. Public guidance on model cards and monitoring supports documenting and managing risk, but it does not satisfy the policy predicates for removing the disclosure concern. On this record, a clean compliance finding is not supported, and even `compliant_with_caveats` would require evidence that the caveat has actually been implemented as a launch condition rather than merely proposed in argument.
remaining_concerns: The encoded action remains `certify_model`, but the admissible record supports certification only if pre-launch disclosure of the shelter-placement limitation is actually made; no new evidence shows that conditioned control is in place.
The current model-card draft still says there are no known material limitations, which conflicts with admissible evidence that the emergency shelter placement slice remains below target.
The draft mitigation runbook is still not an approved mitigation under policy because the accountable owner and alert threshold remain TBD.
No approved risk acceptance or equivalent approval record is in evidence, so the unresolved named-use-case limitation still triggers a disclosure requirement before launch.
